acceptedAnswer.text: Simplr creates brand identities, corporate websites, motion, and communication systems for organisations that need more clarity across how they look, sound, work, and grow.

mainEntity.name: What kind of agency is Simplr?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simplr is a brand identity and digital design agency. Our work spans strategy, branding and design, website design and development, motion, templates, and digital communication systems.

Simplr is based in Cape Town, South Africa. We work with clients locally and internationally, partnering with organisations that need senior brand thinking and digital execution from one integrated studio.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with clients outside South Africa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work with clients in South Africa and around the world, including growing brands, established organisations, and international teams across technology, data, hospitality, retail, professional services, and culture.

mainEntity.name: Can Simplr help with both brand identity and website design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Brand and digital work are connected in our process. We can define or refresh your identity, then translate it into a website, digital platform, motion system, template library, or campaign toolkit.

mainEntity.name: Do you design and develop websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our designers and developers work together from the start, so websites are visually considered, technically sound, responsive, scalable, and built for long-term performance.
It describes how we work. Creative ideas give the brand distinction. Applied design turns those ideas into useful systems. Intelligence keeps the work clear, considered, and built to perform.

Simplr brings strategy, identity, digital platforms, motion, and templates into one connected process. That means the thinking behind the brand carries through into the tools, systems, and experiences people use every day.

mainEntity.name: How do we start a project with Simplr?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most projects start with a conversation about what you are building, changing, or trying to solve. From there, we define the scope, team, timing, and process needed to move the work forward properly.

mainEntity.name: What technology do you use to build websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: We choose the stack around the needs of the project. Our team works across WordPress, Laravel, headless CMS platforms, Vue, Vite, React, modern front-end frameworks, and custom integrations, building websites that are fast, secure, scalable, and easy to manage after launch.
